verdict.rationale: Gide's Global page says it runs 11 offices of its own across multiple countries: Algiers, Brussels, Casablanca, Dakar, Istanbul, London, New York, Paris, Shanghai, Tunis and Warsaw. It notes 40 years in New York and 20 in London, and venture and employee-share work is offered 'in France and internationally', so a founder expanding into these markets may not need a second firm. Missing for 10: evidence of which non-Paris offices hold local-law qualifications or staff the venture/startup practices, and independent corroboration of cross-border delivery beyond first-party claims.
